title: Woodland Scene 6 — Compare and Count
purpose: Adjectives, visible features and counting a small group.

sentenceModels: The fox has a fluffy tail.

adultSupport.focus: Use the scene for describing features and counting.
starterPrompts: Which animal has a fluffy tail?
How many squirrels can you see?
expansionPrompts: Compare the deer and the rabbit.
Tell me two things about the fox.

visualAudit: Small rabbit with long ears in the lower left.
Fox with a big fluffy tail on the right.
Owl with big eyes on a branch.
